prompts.grass: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original seamless terrain material for a sophisticated ancient Chinese Three Kingdoms strategy game's overhead continuous war-map. Create a square 1024x1024 seamless repeating grassland ground texture only. Fully cover the square with quiet natural meadow grass and earth, muted olive-sage, moss jade, straw-green and warm soft soil flecks, cohesive with hand-painted isometric limestone mountains and Han-era cities. Top-down orthographic surface, no horizon and no perspective geometry. Painterly high-quality game ground with broad subtle irregular patches of grass density and a little fine hand-brushed organic detail. Small-scale detail must remain calm at phone map size. Similar brightness across all four edges; truly seamless matching opposite edges, no identifiable central object or large focal patch. Soft overcast warm daylight evenly across the entire plane, no directional cast shadows. No roads, paths, rivers, trees, shrubs, rocks, buildings, flowers, people, grid lines, tile diamonds, text, labels, border, watermark. Avoid bright lime neon, photoreal photography, crunchy high contrast noise, repeated obvious circular tufts, mottled camouflage. This is production raster material, not a game screenshot or mockup.
prompts.water: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original seamless water surface material for a sophisticated ancient Chinese Three Kingdoms strategy game's overhead continuous war-map. Create a square 1024x1024 seamless repeating calm lake/river water surface only, fully opaque edge to edge. Quiet deep jade-teal and muted mineral blue-green, soft painterly variations in depth, sparse delicate pale celadon horizontal ripples and narrow broken reflections. Cohesive with restrained hand-painted isometric limestone mountains, moss-green grasslands and Han-era city sprites. Top-down orthographic surface, no horizon and no perspective geometry. Even lighting across square; matching opposite edges for truly seamless tiling. Medium dark water supports a separately rendered shallower turquoise shoreline overlay; do not paint shores into this texture. Water is readable and textured at mobile map scale but should remain spacious, not busy. No banks, land, islands, plants, stones, boats, fish, foam borders, circular puddles, white tropical caustic webbing, sky or mountain reflections, vortex, text, labels, UI, grid, diamond tiles, border, logo or watermark. Avoid flat cyan fill, bright swimming pool blue, photoreal photograph and harsh glitter. This is production raster material, not a screenshot or mockup.
